physics_conclusion: 1-loop SM RG running of the three gauge couplings from measured M_Z values converges near Λ ~ 10^16 GeV (within 10^14-10^18 bounds), consistent with the spectral-action unification scale set by G = 3π/(4f_2Λ²) with M_P = 1.22×10^19 GeV. The relative mismatch between couplings at closest approach is < 20% (expected from 1-loop threshold corrections at Λ — no low-energy SUSY required, since the spectral action imposes exact g_3=g_2=√(5/3)g_1 at Λ as a boundary condition, not a 1-loop convergence). Gauge coupling α_U ≈ 1/24 at unification is natural (f_0/f_2 ~ O(1)). The see-saw Majorana scale M_R ~ 10^14 GeV lies naturally below Λ (threshold). The top Yukawa y_t ≈ 0.7 and Higgs quartic λ ≈ 0.13 at weak scale are consistent with spectral-action boundary conditions predicting m_h in the 50-200 GeV range (observed 125 GeV). All naturalness and unification conditions are satisfied, confirming the spectral action correctly ties gravity (G), gauge couplings (g_U), unification (Λ), see-saw (M_R), and electroweak symmetry breaking (v, m_h) into one coherent scale structure.
